definitions.explanation: The two opposite sides of something — a road, a body, a piece of paper, an argument. Used for spatial sides and, by extension, two opposing parties or viewpoints.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両側|りょうがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are blooming on both sides of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両側|りょうがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}して→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please print on both sides of the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{両側|りょうがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To solve the problem, we need to hear the opinions of both sides.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧ (both) + ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). The ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ reading shifts to dakuon in this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両側|りょうがわ}: both sides of the road
- {両側|りょうがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up on both sides
- {両側|りょうがわ}⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧: two-way traffic
- {両側|りょうがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: opinions from both sides

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧: both — abstract pair (both options, both people); not spatial
- ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧: left and right — specifically left-right axis
- ⟦{両端|りょうたん}→両端：11356_ryoutan⟧: both ends — the endpoints rather than the sides
